bounded_runtime_sequence: Installer selects the production or fake transport registration and sends a publish request with a request identifier to the local broker process.
Broker receives the request through cross-process IPC and routes both transports into the same broker handler.
Broker validates the message and begins the broker-owned publication transaction.
Broker serializes concurrent requests for the same identifier, stages one versioned record, and atomically replaces the current durable record.
Broker records the publication outcome and acknowledges the installer.
If acknowledgement is lost, the installer retries the same identifier and the broker replays the recorded outcome without publishing twice.
Rollback follows the same request, transaction, durable publication, acknowledgement, and replay lifecycle to restore the prior version.
End-to-end verification exercises installer wiring, broker handling, durable publication semantics, retry behavior, rollback, and the shared publication oracle together.
candidate_bounded_sequence: Installer wiring and transport -> cross-process publish request -> shared broker handler -> validation and broker-owned serialized transaction -> versioned staging and atomic durable-record replacement -> recorded outcome and acknowledgement -> same-identifier retry replay or rollback through the same lifecycle -> shared-oracle end-to-end verification.
shared_semantics_that_must_remain_fixed: The request identifier is the idempotency identity for publication and outcome replay.
The broker-owned publication transaction is authoritative for same-identifier serialization.
A successful publication stages exactly one versioned record and atomically replaces the current durable record.
A lost acknowledgement followed by the same request identifier replays the recorded outcome and must not publish twice.
Rollback uses the same request and publication lifecycle to restore the prior version.
Production and fake transports must enter the same broker handler and be evaluated by the same publication oracle.
why_one_bounded_parent_pass_is_insuffici: 該当しない。installer wiring、cross-process request、broker-owned transaction、durable publication、acknowledgement retry、rollback、production/fake transport、および end-to-end oracle は一つの明示された lifecycle に収束し、単一の bounded implementation / verification pass で順序、authority、production wiring、test oracle を保てる。
failure_mode_that_decomposition_prevents: 具体的な decomposition 必須 failure mode は evidence に存在しない。むしろ分割すると、request identity、transaction serialization、atomic replacement、outcome replay、rollback、production wiring、shared oracle の結合検証が別 slice に分離され、fake-only success や IPC と durable-state semantics の不一致を見逃すおそれがある。
evidence_that_would_lower_the_profile: 変更が既存の検証済み broker contract と production wiring を変えず、単一の局所的・機械的修正だけであり、retry、atomic replacement、rollback、transport registration の再検証が不要だと示す evidence があれば、contract-kernel または lightweight へ下げられる。
evidence_that_would_raise_the_profile: 別所有の consumer protocol、独立 release unit、複数の独立 runtime sequence、競合する state authority、または単一 pass では維持できない cross-slice identity・ordering・rollback semantics が示され、具体的な decomposition failure modeまで source-backed で説明できれば full-coverage へ上げる。
